title: Subscription Renewal Leak Radar
oneLiner: A renewal-defense console for B2B SaaS finance and CS teams that surfaces which accounts are quietly sliding toward churn because usage, champion activity, and invoice friction are deteriorating at the same time.
targetUser: Revenue operations leads, customer success managers, and finance owners at small to mid-sized B2B SaaS companies.
keyUX: Rank renewal risk by ARR at stake, open one account, and see the exact mix of product silence, stakeholder decay, and billing friction that needs intervention this week.
stitchPrompt: Design a desktop B2B SaaS renewal defense console called Subscription Renewal Leak Radar for revenue operations leads, customer success managers, and finance owners. It should help teams protect recurring revenue by showing which accounts are drifting toward churn because usage is fading, internal champions are going silent, and invoice issues are stacking up before the renewal date. Include an ARR at-risk KPI strip, a renewal risk priority queue, an account health timeline, a champion and stakeholder map, an invoice friction panel, and a save-plan action drawer. Design direction: use an operator-dense aesthetic with disciplined navy and charcoal structure, tight revenue-ops hierarchy, one sharp alert accent, and compact scan-friendly modules so the product feels margin-aware, urgent, and brutally actionable.
